svg.title: mla-absorb
svg.desc: Weight absorption. The score q_i^T W_UK,i c_j is re-bracketed as (W_UK,i^T q_i)^T c_j, so each of the 128 heads gets a 576-dimensional query (512 absorbed + 64 RoPE) and all heads read the same cached 576-element row: MQA with one KV head, d_k 576, d_v 512. W_UV folds into the output projection. Per cached token and layer in BF16: 1,152 bytes and 278,528 FLOPs, intensity about 242 FLOP/B (2·H_q), versus 1 for an expanded MHA cache; H100 ridge 295. Toy check: 7·(2·4+3·5) = 161 = 14·4 + 21·5.
